title: Wonderful tour
text: We had an amazing day at The Alhambra. Javi is from Motril and has so much knowledge and passion about The Alhambra. We were picked up at the gangway and everything went smoothly. Javi is a great photographer too and took pictures for us. We felt like VIP’s for the day!
author: O9701XUdeborahl

title: The only way to see it!
text: Fernando was the best tour guide! His knowledge about Alhambra and his excitement about sharing it made it unforgettable! Jose made the process so easy- it was great having them!
author: Tonja_C

title: A worrisome tour turned perfect!
text: Javi is an excellent tour host.  He went out of his way to accommodate our needs, even after we determined that Viator had not passed on our mobility limitations to him.  Our personal guide, Esther, met us at the gate of Alhambra.  She has a wealth of knowledge but more importantly, she was respectful of our limitations and ensured we took our time and had breaks along our tour.  At the end of our tour, Esther ensured that we made it to our reserved lunch table and arranged for our ride back to the port.  The restaurant that Javi had reserved for us was beautiful. title: Trip of a Lifetime to Granada and the Alhambra Made Possible Thanks to Javier and his team at Tours de Lao a Lao
text:
Javier was prompt, professional, and personable in all of our dealings—from the booking process through sharing specific itinerary details and supplying contact information for him, our guide, and driver—thereby ensuring comfortable immersion into our tour experience without worry or concern. 

Our tour guide, Alberto, asked about our interests when we first met and then set out to tailor our tour accordingly. Having grown up in the area, his insights and personal stories were invaluable.  In addition to learning the history of the area, it was fascinating to hear about how things have changed
author: Kharma_C

title: Wonderful day in Alhambra.
text: Experience was wonderful. Driver was on time at the port and Javier was knowledgable and informative. This was a great day and a great tour. I would highly recommend.
author: NikkiFre2026

title: Alhambra Tour
text: Javier was in communication with us the day before and the morning of our tour. The information made us feel very comfortable and stress free. Alberto was our tour guide in Alhambra and he was amazing. The historical information and stories he shared were well paced and entertaining. He always made sure we had whatever we needed. He is very personable and set the bar high for all our future tours.
author: debbieo980

title: The Absolute Best Way to See the Alhambra from the Cruise Port!
text:
We booked this private tour during our cruise stop, and it was hands-down the highlight of our entire trip to Spain. If you are on a tight schedule but want a high-quality, stress-free experience, this is the way to do it.

Our driver, Santiago, met us right at the port as soon as we disembarked. He was incredibly professional, polite, and navigating the roads flawlessly. The vehicle was clean and very comfortable. title: Money and time well spent - don‘t hesitate to do this tour if the Alhambra is on your must-see list
text: We went on this private tour to the Alhambra with high expectations as we expected it to be our last chance to visit due to illnesses and high age (my mother is 89-year old and needs a wheelchair) and were therefore very picky with choosing a tour operator. Here, our communication beforehand was easy, reassuring and questions always prompted instantaneous answers. title: Amazing Alhambra
text: Javi was very knowledgeable, accommodating and has a real passion for what he does!  He was able to make transportation arrangements from a port further away and the driver he found was great.  All in all this tour with Javi was excellent and we highly recommend!!
